triples.head_surface: siphoning action causing damage to the pump
triples.tail_surface: siphon breaker is used in the line
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 管路中使用虹吸破坏器
triples.evidence_text: Do not terminate the discharge line at a level lower than that of the liquid being pumped unless a siphon breaker is used in the line. Otherwise, a siphoning action causing damage to the pump could result.

triples.head_surface: excessive shock pressure and reverse rotation
triples.tail_surface: throttling valve and a system check valve be installed in the discharge line
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在排出管路安装节流阀和系统止回阀
triples.evidence_text: With high discharge heads, it is recommended that a throttling valve and a system check valve be installed in the discharge line to protect the pump from excessive shock pressure and reverse rotation when it is stopped.

triples.head_surface: self-priming centrifugal pump will not prime
triples.tail_surface: sufficient static liquid head to hold the discharge check valve closed
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 静液头足以使排出止回阀保持关闭
triples.evidence_text: A self-priming centrifugal pump will not prime if there is sufficient static liquid head to hold the discharge check valve closed.

triples.head_surface: self-priming centrifugal pump will not prime
triples.tail_surface: discharge side of the pump must be opened to atmospheric pressure through a bypass line installed between the pump discharge and the check valve
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过安装在泵排出口与止回阀之间的旁通管将泵排出口通大气
triples.evidence_text: However, if a check valve has been installed in the discharge line, the discharge side of the pump must be opened to atmospheric pressure through a bypass line installed between the pump discharge and the check valve. A self-priming centrifugal pump will not prime if there is sufficient static liquid head to hold the discharge check valve closed.

triples.tail_surface: use a valve as large as the largest pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用与最大管径等大的阀门
triples.evidence_text: If a throttling valve is desired in the discharge line, use a valve as large as the largest pipe to minimize friction losses.
